summary: Within this candidate chunk, the highest Serenity research priority is the regulated healthcare and credential pathway subset, led by Afya, because medical education capacity has clearer demand durability, licensing friction, and public-market purity than broad consumer tutoring or student-loan finance. Laureate ranks next as a purer international higher-ed operator, while Nelnet and Graham Holdings are useful infrastructure or services checks but have lower theme purity. China tutoring names remain researchable but are penalized for regulatory uncertainty and weaker chokepoint clarity. Navient is deprioritized because legacy credit and regulatory risk may dominate the education-theme signal.
